component.name: Termalime
component.summary: A terminal emulator with an integrated local Ollama co-pilot and MCP client

description.p: Termalime is a Tauri-powered desktop cockpit that fuses a full terminal emulator with a local AI chat co-pilot. Built for developers who constantly bounce between shell sessions and LLM prompts, everything lives in a unified split-pane workspace.

ul.li: Model Context Protocol (MCP) client core supporting stdio servers and automated tool discovery.
Local Provider Gateway with configurable Ollama host endpoint and zero cloud leakage.
Preflight safety engine that analyzes commands before execution to prevent accidental damage.
Performance telemetry displaying real-time generation speed (tok/s) and time-to-first-token (TTFT).
Targeted context chips allowing 1-click injection of last command output, git diff, or directory tree.
Eco-telemetry calculating estimated energy and water savings from local model execution.

screenshot.caption: Termalime split-pane workspace with terminal and AI assistant

description.p: Codename: Protocol. Introducing Model Context Protocol (MCP) support, configurable Ollama host gateway, performance telemetry (tok/s, TTFT), and targeted workspace context chips.
Bug fixes and terminal stability improvements.
Codename: Bridge. Interactive AI code block execution, error diagnosis, in-buffer search, and smart CWD inheritance.
